answer: Quadratic slashing commitments bind every validator to a jetty-like liquidity sink: capital locked in marble-grade collateral erodes as k^2 when slashing mass expands, while Sybil cluster costs rise super-linearly because each additional node requires proportional bonding plus correlated liquidation risk.
